verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a public API with API-key management that lets users programmatically search 138M+ papers, generate research reports, and run full systematic reviews end to end. The pricing page lists API access, and all API functionality is also exposed via an MCP server. The OpenAPI probe found nothing on the support domain, but that is an absence of evidence, not a contradiction. missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec or endpoint-level reference in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically: search 138 million+ academic papers and generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows.
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
